The business need

Start with what's getting in the way.

Technology should support the work your organization needs to do. A focused conversation can help establish priorities.

  • Cloud services are difficult to administer.
  • User, device or access setup is inconsistent.
  • Manual IT tasks take time away from other work.
  • There is limited visibility into assets, updates or service health.

Cloud, productivity and IT management, scoped around your needs.

Frequently asked questions

Before we get started.

Can you work with our current cloud provider?

An engagement can begin with your existing provider, subscriptions and configuration. Proposed changes depend on the initial review.

Do you provide Microsoft 365 support?

Microsoft 365 configuration and productivity assistance are available to enquire about. Tasks are agreed in scope.

Can management be ongoing?

Ongoing administration can be considered where a suitable support scope is agreed. No service level is implied without written agreement.
